# WebsiteBanja AI

> Autonomous AI Website Builder & Conversational Architect

WebsiteBanja AI (https://websitebanja.com) is a production-grade autonomous web design platform that plans, writes, designs, structures, and publishes modern responsive websites in seconds. It bridges the gap between high-level human intent and production-ready web experiences.

## Core Capabilities

### 1. Mitra — Voice & Text AI Website Architect
- **Conversational Planning**: Talk naturally via real-time bidirectional voice (WebSockets / Gemini Live API) or high-speed streaming text with Mitra.
- **Requirement Extraction**: Dynamically extracts business name, industry category, value proposition, color schemes, section architectures, and target audience.
- **Project Knowledge Base**: Synthesizes verified user requirements into persistent, versioned design blueprints.
- **Direct Studio URL**: https://websitebanja.com/agent

### 2. Autonomous Multi-Section Website Generator
- **Multi-Category AI Generation**: Generates contextual copy, curated imagery, and layout structures for dentists, restaurants, SaaS platforms, gyms, creative portfolios, corporate services, and e-commerce.
- **Dual AI Provider Pipeline**: Resilient architecture using OpenAI as the primary generator with automated fallback to Google Gemini.
- **Production Modern Code**: Produces responsive, accessible layouts with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion animations, and modern typography.

### 3. Visual Studio Editor
- **WYSIWYG Editing**: Inline text editing, real-time font and palette customizer, and media replacements.
- **Section Reordering & Structure**: Drag-and-drop section arrangement, duplicate sections, and dynamic section insertion.
- **Multi-Viewport Previews**: Pixel-perfect previews across Desktop (1280px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) viewports.

### 4. 1-Click Instant Publishing
- **Global CDN Delivery**: Instant deployment to high-speed CDN infrastructure with automated SSL certificates.
- **Public Subdomains & Slugs**: Every published site receives an isolated, public-facing URL at `https://websitebanja.com/p/[slug]`.

## Infrastructure & Enterprise Security

- **Hosting & Compute**: Azure Container Apps (`websitebanja-app`) in `centralindia` with automated scaling and zero-downtime rolling revisions.
- **Continuous Deployment**: GitHub Actions automated CI/CD pipeline triggered on verified git pushes to `main`.
- **Database & Storage**: Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server with tenant-isolated Row Level Security (RLS) and Azure Blob Storage (`websitebanjastorage`) for user uploads.
- **Authentication**: Supabase Auth supporting secure Google OAuth 2.0 and email credentials.
- **Security Protections**: Rate-limiting with exponential backoff, Content Security Policy (CSP), strict input sanitization, and immutable audit logs.

## Canonical Public Endpoints

- Homepage: https://websitebanja.com
- Mitra AI Website Architect: https://websitebanja.com/agent
- Sitemap: https://websitebanja.com/sitemap.xml

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Do I need coding or design skills to use WebsiteBanja?**
  None at all. You describe your business and the autonomous AI writes the copy, pairs palettes, structures sections, and renders the website in the visual studio.
- **Can I customize the website after the AI builds it?**
  Yes. WebsiteBanja includes a complete visual Studio Editor to edit text, reorder sections, adjust brand colors, and add sections with real-time live preview.
- **How does the Free Plan work?**
  The Free Plan allows up to 3 AI requests per 7-day rolling window, providing full access to planning, generation, the visual editor, autosave, and free public publishing.
- **Is the generated website responsive on mobile and tablet?**
  Yes. Every layout adapts fluidly across Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile screens with instant in-studio viewport switching.
- **How does 1-click publishing work?**
  Clicking 'Publish' deploys the site to a high-speed global CDN with SSL encryption and a permanent public link.
